_about: The six Pacific seats of ruling 209 (China, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Manchukuo, Mongolia), in the shapes of the files the rules builder lifts them into at step 13. Top-level keys are the target files. Written by make_seats.py from the historian's and the planner's files, so it is never edited by hand. The paper beside it (seats.md) says what each block is and what is still open.

years.1939: At war with Japan for two years, and losing. The coast, the railways and the old capital are in enemy hands, and the government has gone up the Yangtze to Chungking. Sixty-two thin divisions short of guns, a small air force and no navy. Japan's army beats yours wherever it masses, and no help is coming soon. Hold the mountains, give ground, and let the war behind the lines bleed an enemy who cannot garrison a country this size.

At war beside Britain from the first evening, half a world from the fighting. Nine very thin divisions of part-time Militia, five cruisers and five old destroyers guard a whole continent. Raise volunteer divisions and send them where Britain needs them, or keep them home and watch Japan. If Japan comes south you cannot stop a great power alone: Britain's fleet at Singapore, and one day perhaps America's, is your shield.

At war beside Britain from the first night: where Britain goes, you go. One thin division of part-time Territorials and one cruiser at home. You cannot defend yourself against a great power and nobody expects you to. Raise your one volunteer division, send it where it counts, guard your islands, and matter at the margin.

Siam became Thailand in June, the one country of South-East Asia that is nobody's colony. Five thin divisions, two coastal defence ships and four submarines, with France's colonies to the east, Britain's to the south and west, and Japan looking for a road through you. You cannot beat any of the three. Staying out is a quiet game of rice and trade: a fight comes only if you choose one. Keep your independence however you can.

A state made by Japan in 1932, with Japan's army on its soil and Japan's officials in its ministries. You are at war with China from the first day, beside Japan. If Japan and the Soviet Union ever fight, you are in that war too: a client has no say. Four thin divisions, the steel of Anshan and the coal of Fushun, and the Soviet Union and Mongolia on three sides. You would not outlive your patron's defeat.

A people's republic recognised by no one but Moscow, with the Red Army on its soil. Two small cavalry divisions have just fought beside it at Khalkhin Gol, where Japan's attack on your border was broken in August. You are at war with nobody. If Japan and the Soviet Union ever fight, you are in that war from its first month: a client has no say. Watch the eastern frontier, and ride with the Red Army if it goes east.

traits.name: War behind the lines
traits.text: Japan holds the cities and the railways. The villages and hills between them belong to Chinese guerrillas, Communist and Nationalist alike. Every month an enemy corps standing in occupied Chinese mountains, hills and forests loses part of its strength to raids and ambushes.

traits.name: A country too large to conquer
traits.text: China has lost its coast, its capital and most of its industry, and fights on from the mountains of the interior.
traits.rule: China asks for terms only when nearly all it holds of worth is lost: 97 parts in a hundred, where most countries give in at about half.

traits.name: A dominion of the Crown
traits.text: Australia went to war on the same evening as Britain, 3 September 1939.
traits.rule: At war with Britain's enemies from the first day. Led by the computer it follows Britain into each new war while the two stand in one alliance; in a player's hands it goes to a new war only when its player says so.

unit.label: AIF division
unit.text: Volunteers for service anywhere, raised because the law keeps the Militia at home. Four divisions were raised in 1939 and 1940. They held Tobruk, fought at El Alamein and turned the Japanese back in New Guinea.

traits.name: A dominion of the Crown
traits.text: New Zealand dated its war from the same hour as Britain's, 3 September 1939.
traits.rule: At war with Britain's enemies from the first day. Led by the computer it follows Britain into each new war while the two stand in one alliance; in a player's hands it goes to a new war only when its player says so.

unit.label: New Zealand Division
unit.text: The country's whole field army abroad: one division of volunteers that sailed in January 1940 and fought in Greece, Crete, the desert and Italy, known above all for its attacks by night.

traits.name: Rice, teak and tin
traits.text: One of the world's great rice exporters, with the teak of the north and the tin and rubber of the south, sold to whoever sends ships for them. It pays while Thailand is at peace.

traits.name: Bends before the storm
traits.text: A small kingdom that has kept its independence by giving way to the stronger power in time, as it agreed a cease-fire within hours of Japan's landings in December 1941.
traits.rule: Thailand asks for terms early: when 20 parts in a hundred of what it holds of worth are lost.

traits.name: Made and held by Japan
traits.text: Japan's army made the state in 1932, commands its soldiers and stands on its soil.
traits.rule: At war with China from the first day, beside Japan. The month Japan is at war with the Soviet Union or Mongolia, Manchukuo is too, whoever leads it. A country at war with Manchukuo is at war with Japan.

traits.name: Coal and steel for another's army
traits.text: The steel of Anshan, the coal of Fushun and the arsenal at Mukden, built up to feed Japan's army.
traits.rule: Its three factories, at Mukden and Anshan, pay into its budget as any factory does. They are on the map, and nothing is added for them.

traits.name: Horsemen of the steppe
traits.text: Cavalry that lives off the grass and crosses country no lorry can, as the Mongolian divisions crossed the Gobi beside the Red Army's tanks in August 1945.

traits.name: The protocol of 1936
traits.text: Bound to the Soviet Union by a pact of mutual help, with Soviet troops in the country from 1937.
traits.rule: The month the Soviet Union is at war with Japan or Manchukuo, Mongolia is too, whoever leads it. A country at war with Mongolia is at war with the Soviet Union. It follows the Soviet Union into no other war.
